query: For my 54-year-old male, among men aged 49–59 whose initial Troponin T exceeded the dataset 99th-percentile ULN, report cohort size, ULN, p25, median (p50), p75 and value range.
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mtt.subject_id) AS cohort_size, mtt.value AS uln, percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY mtt.value) AS p25, percentile_cont(0.50) within GROUP (ORDER BY mtt.value) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY mtt.value) AS p75, mtr.interquartile_range AS value_range FROM male_troponin_t_values mtt JOIN male_troponin_t_range mtr ON TRUE;
